subject: Kickoff: Technical Liaisons & Evaluation timeline for Helium Analytics
content:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.inference>
To: Jordan Cole <jordan.cole@heliumanalytics.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.inference>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.inference>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff: Technical Liaisons & Evaluation timeline for Helium Analytics

Hi Jordan / Priya —

Thanks again for taking the time last week. As discussed, I wanted to introduce the technical team who will partner with Helium on the evaluation and outline a proposed short MAP so everyone has the same expectations up front.

Core goals for the next 6 weeks:
- Confirm integration test plan (data paths + API auth)
- Run evaluation workloads at production-ish latency (sample traffic)
- Validate cost/per-token profiles and recommended batching/quantization
- Deliver a short runbook for going to Dedicated if you decide to commit

Technical liaisons:
- Dev Patel (Solutions Engineer) — will own integration and smoke tests
- Rishi Malhotra (ML Eng) — will own model config, quantization recommendations, and performance tuning

Proposed MAP milestones (attached spreadsheet has details):
1) Week 0 (this week): Kickoff + access provisioning
2) Week 1: Integration tests (small dataset) + baseline perf run
3) Week 2–3: Optimization (batching/kv cache/quant profiles) + updated perf/cost report
4) Week 4: Acceptance run with larger traffic sample and final recommendations

Action items for Helium:
- Jordan / Priya: confirm the S3 buckets that will be used for test payloads and the IAM user we should use for temporary access
- Please confirm who will be the primary engineering contact for network/VPC questions (if any)

Attachments: Helium_MAP_v1.xlsx (proposed timeline + owners), evaluation-checklist.md (test cases).

Available times for a 30-minute technical handshake tomorrow (All times PT): 10:00, 11:30, 15:00. Tell me what works and Dev/Rishi will join.

Thanks — excited to get started.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.inference


----
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.inference>
To: Jordan Cole <jordan.cole@heliumanalytics.com>, Priya Mohan <priya.mohan@heliumanalytics.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.inference>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Technical Liaisons & Evaluation timeline for Helium Analytics

Hi Jordan / Priya — quick intro from me.

High level on our side: I’ll validate auth (API keys / temporary IAM roles), get a small synthetic payload through our hosted API to establish a baseline, and then we’ll iterate on batching and caching configs. For the initial integration I usually ask for:
- Small sample payloads (100 requests) in S3 or as a signed URL
- One test account (temp API key) or an IAM user for S3 access

If you can drop the S3 path into the shared Drive link, I’ll pick it up and kick off the baseline. I’ll also bring up two quick test plans in the spreadsheet: minimal smoke and perf baseline.

Cheers,
Dev Patel
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference


----
From: Jordan Cole <jordan.cole@heliumanalytics.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.inference>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.inference>
Cc: Priya Mohan <priya.mohan@heliumanalytics.com>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 12:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Technical Liaisons & Evaluation timeline for Helium Analytics

Thanks Kimberly and Dev — this looks good. I’ve just added Priya (our Eng Lead) to the thread.

Priya: we’ll be the primary engineering contact. I can create a temp S3 bucket and a short-lived IAM user by end of day. I’ll also upload a sample of our typical inference payloads (a few hundred records) to the Drive folder Kimberly shared.

As for the handshake slot, 11:30 PT tomorrow works for me.

Jordan Cole
Head of Platform Engineering, Helium Analytics
jordan.cole@heliumanalytics.com


----
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.inference>
To: Jordan Cole <jordan.cole@heliumanalytics.com>, Priya Mohan <priya.mohan@heliumanalytics.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.inference>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.inference>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 26 May 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Technical Liaisons & Evaluation timeline for Helium Analytics

Great — 11:30 PT tomorrow is booked. I’ve sent a calendar invite to everyone.

Quick note on scope: during the handshake we’ll confirm the exact list of test cases in evaluation-checklist.md and who owns each validation. Post-meeting Dev will trigger the smoke baseline and Rishi will triage model config items we should try first (16-bit fp / 4-bit quant tradeoffs).

If there are any compliance items (SOC2 evidence, IP concerns), please flag now so I can route to our security compliance lead.

See you tomorrow.

Thanks,
Kimberly


----
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.inference>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.inference>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.inference>, Jordan Cole <jordan.cole@heliumanalytics.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.inference>
Date: Thu, 27 May 2027 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Technical Liaisons & Evaluation timeline for Helium Analytics

Thanks for the quick sync today — good alignment. Following up with the immediate items I promised:
- I pushed an initial model-config matrix into the Drive folder (configs we’ll try first: fp16, int8-quant, int4-quant with KV cache preserved).
- I added an estimated cost delta row to the MAP spreadsheet so you can see the token-cost impact per config.
- Next step: Dev will run the smoke baseline against the fp16 config and we’ll review results on Monday.

If you want me to include a sample inference-traffic simulator script (Python) to run locally against the hosted endpoint, I can drop that in the Drive as well.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
ML Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced in thread:
- Helium_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet with milestone rows and owner column)
- evaluation-checklist.md (test cases & acceptance criteria)
